meta.model: PUMA/MOSYS Baltic Artesian Basin hydrogeological model
meta.datum: Model elevation in metres above sea level; exact vertical datum is not stated in the point service.
meta.mesh: Original variable-resolution triangular-prism mesh; no spatial resampling.
meta.citation: University of Latvia, ESF PUMA project; Virbulis et al. (2013), Hydrogeology Journal 21(4), 845–862.
meta.boundary: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; simplified Estonia administrative boundary used only to clip the model subset.
